h1: The Loft Resort Kabin Buri, Prachinburi — a small loft-style boutique resort with clean, quiet rooms on the Kabin Buri–Korat road
intro: If you're driving out of Bangkok toward Korat or Khao Yai, passing through Kabin Buri on Route 304, and you want a place that isn't the same old hotel room but something small, clean, quiet and a bit stylish in the few-hundred-baht range — The Loft Resort Kabin Buri is the name travellers passing through mention warmly in their reviews · It's a small, owner-run boutique resort of about 8 rooms, looked after by the owners themselves, decorated in bare-concrete loft style in grey-black tones with orange accents, at 111/1 Kabin Buri–Korat Road, Mueang Kao subdistrict · What real reviews agree on is that the rooms are very clean and quiet, because the place sits back from the main road, and the owners and staff are friendly and take good care of guests, with fast check-in · Every room has AC, satellite TV, a fridge, and self-serve tea, coffee and Ovaltine, plus parking right outside the room · Prices start at around THB 600/night, with real review scores around 8.1–8.2 and value as high as 9.0 on Booking.com.

body.html: Who The Loft Resort Kabin Buri suits — to put it as briefly as possible, The Loft Resort Kabin Buri is a place for "travellers passing through who want a clean, quiet, tasteful place to sleep in the few-hundred-baht range," more than for anyone hunting for a full-service resort with a pool and spa · It isn't a high-rise hotel with a gym like Kantary Kabin Buri, and it isn't a riverside hillside resort selling nature views — it's a small, owner-run boutique resort of about 8 rooms, decorated in bare-concrete loft style for a contemporary, understated feel, sitting on the Kabin Buri–Korat road in Mueang Kao subdistrict, Kabin Buri district · The people it suits best, and who come up most in reviews, are travellers driving from Bangkok toward Korat or Isan on Route 304 who want to stop for a night, because it's easy to get on and off the main road and there's parking right outside the room · Another group is couples and solo travellers who don't need a lot of facilities but want a clean room, a quiet feel, and a place that looks better than its price, along with people running errands in Kabin Buri or using it as a budget base for the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai · Real reviews echo the same thing: the strengths here are cleanliness, the quiet from sitting back off the road, the warm, host-style care, and value for money that many rate especially highly · On the flip side, if you're after a resort with a pool, a breakfast buffet, or roomy common areas, this may not be the answer, because its appeal lies in being small, quiet, clean and stylish, not in a full range of services.

Location and getting there — the resort's address is 111/1 Kabin Buri–Korat Road, Mueang Kao subdistrict, Kabin Buri district, Prachinburi 25240, on the early stretch of Highway 304 running from Kabin Buri up toward Wang Nam Khiao district and Korat · The number-one location selling point reviews mention is that the resort sits well back from the main road, so it stays fairly quiet and you don't hear traffic constantly the way you do at places right on the roadside, while still being easy to get on and off the main road and easy to find, with no deep side soi to turn into · Within a short distance there are restaurants, convenience stores and petrol stations to stop at, and the Tiger Shrine (Chao Pho Suea Shrine) is about 1.6 km away as a nearby spot to pay respects, while Wat Sisa Mueang and meditation centres in the area are within about 5 km · For longer journeys: this is a well-placed stop on the Bangkok–Korat route, since it's about a 2-hour drive from Bangkok and about 2 hours from Suvarnabhumi Airport as well · Kabin Buri railway station is about 12 km away, and the town of Kabin Buri itself is a short drive away · Anyone wanting to use it as a base to continue on can easily drive up to the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai or out to Wang Nam Khiao on Route 304 · One honest note worth knowing is that Kabin Buri is a small town and this is a small resort with no shuttle service, so having your own car is the most convenient and flexible option, because calling a taxi or finding public transport here at night isn't as easy as in a big city, and you may need to drive a little to find certain food.

"Drove from Bangkok toward Korat and stopped here for a night. The room was very clean and quiet because it sits back from the road, the owner was kind and check-in was fast, and you can park right outside your room — for a stopover at this price it's more than worth it."

Room types and decor — what sets The Loft Resort Kabin Buri apart from similarly priced places in Kabin Buri is its bare-concrete loft decor in grey-black tones, accented with orange lettering and details in line with the resort's name, looking more contemporary and full of character than a typical roadside stay, even at a few-hundred-baht price · There are several room types to choose from according to the booking platforms · It starts with the Double Room, a King bed for a couple or solo traveller; the Twin Room, two single beds for friends or couples who want separate beds; the Double Room with Terrace, which adds a private balcony sitting area; and the King Room with a large bed · Every room comes with AC, a roughly 25-inch flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a small fridge, free drinking water, and a drinks corner with tea, coffee and Ovaltine, plus a few snacks like biscuits and instant congee/noodles you can make yourself · The bathroom is en-suite with a shower, and there's private parking right outside the room · What real reviews most consistently praise is that the rooms are very clean and bigger than expected — many use words like "spotless" and "spacious, great value," reflecting how attentively the owners keep things clean · The honest note reviews raise is that the bathroom is fairly small, which is common in small places like this, so if a roomy bathroom matters a lot to you, set your expectations accordingly · Overall the decor and room condition punch above the price, and they're the main reason people remember this place after stopping by.

Facilities and common areas — it has to be said up front that The Loft Resort Kabin Buri is a small place focused on simplicity, not a full-service resort, so don't expect a pool, gym, spa or roomy common areas like a big hotel · What it does have, and what reviews mention positively, is free Wi-Fi, free private parking right outside every room, a reception desk reachable 24 hours, and the in-room tea-coffee-Ovaltine corner, which makes an overnight stay convenient enough for basic needs · Having parking right outside the room is something self-drivers love, because it's easy to load and unload and you feel safer with the car in sight · The overall feel of the resort is quiet and calm, better suited to stopping for a night or a short errand stay than spending the whole day at the property · Because it's a small resort, the feel is friendly, more like staying at a relative's house than a hotel, which many people like for the privacy and lack of crowds · The thing to understand is that, with few common facilities, the charm here is in the rooms and the care, not in resort activities or amenities, so if you grasp that before booking, you'll be easy to please.

Food and what's around — the thing to be clear about is that The Loft Resort Kabin Buri doesn't have a restaurant or a full breakfast buffet · What it has is the in-room drinks-and-snacks corner with tea, coffee, Ovaltine, biscuits, and instant congee or noodles you can make yourself, enough for a light breakfast or a late-night bite, but not freshly cooked food · The upside is that the Kabin Buri–Korat roadside location and the town of Kabin Buri have restaurants, cafes, convenience stores and markets to choose from within a short drive, so finding breakfast and main meals out isn't hard, and many people who stop here plan to pick up supplies from a convenience store or head out to try local Kabin Buri eateries · For those driving Route 304 up to Wang Nam Khiao, there are also several cafes and restaurants with nice views to stop at along the way · From this angle, not having a restaurant at the resort isn't a big problem for travellers with a car, since it's a chance to go out and try local food · But if you expect breakfast served right at the property when you wake up, plan your own breakfast in advance, because this place isn't designed to provide that.

Service — service is one of the strengths most praised in real reviews, and it's the particular charm of a small, owner-run place · Both foreign and Thai reviews agree that the owners and staff are friendly, warm, kind and helpful — some reviews say check-in was "very fast and efficient" with no long wait, and the owners are happy to recommend restaurants or onward routes · Service like this makes many guests feel they've received a warm, personal welcome rather than the formality of a big hotel · On Booking.com, the staff/service category sits at around 8.6, which is high for a small place · To be straight about it, the service limits that come with being a small resort are that there are no big-hotel extras like a shuttle, room service, or multiple departments, and at times when the owners aren't around you may need to reach them by phone · But overall the feedback leans clearly positive, and the owners' attentive care is why many people give high marks for the impression and say they'd stay again if they pass this way.

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — pulling together Booking.com, Trip.com and Tripadvisor, the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: rooms very clean, even "spotless"; a quiet feel from sitting back off the main road; spacious rooms and loft-style decor that looks better than the price; friendly, helpful owners and staff with fast check-in; convenient parking outside the room; and value for money that many call the standout · On Booking.com it scores around 8.1 from about 25 reviews, with high marks in value 9.0, location 8.7, staff 8.6, comfort 8.5, plus cleanliness 8.2 and facilities 8.1 · On Trip.com it's around 8.2, and on Tripadvisor it gets around 4.0 out of 5, ranked #3 of 6 specialty stays in Kabin Buri, with a Guests' Choice award · On the gripes side: the most-mentioned point is that the bathroom is fairly small, a limit of this room style · Next is that there are few common facilities (no pool, no freshly cooked breakfast), and being a small place, the room count and number of online reviews are still limited · On top of that, because it's near the road, some rooms may catch a little traffic noise at times, though overall it's considered quiet · These gripes are manageable by setting expectations correctly — that you're staying at a small, simple place — rather than being issues that leave people disappointed.

"Spotless and very comfortable, in a quiet spot set back from the main road, with spacious rooms that are great value and lovely owners · The only downside is the bathroom is a touch small; everything else impressed me, and I'll definitely come back if I pass this way again."

Price and value — The Loft Resort Kabin Buri starts at around THB 600/night (about USD 16–22 on international platforms) for a Double or Twin at normal rates, edging up a little for rooms with a balcony (Double with Terrace) or the King Room, as well as during long weekends when more people travel · Compared with other places in Kabin Buri and Prachinburi, you first have to understand that The Loft plays in a different market from five-star serviced apartments like Kantary Hotel Kabinburi, which run from the low thousands and have a pool, gym and full breakfast, and it's a different style from riverside hillside resorts selling a nature setting · Among few-hundred-baht stays on Route 304, The Loft is in a similar range to The Resort Kabinburi (from about THB 450), but what makes The Loft worth it in its own way is tasteful loft decor, the cleanliness reviews call a standout, the quiet from sitting back off the road, and host-style care that make it feel like more than what you pay, especially the 9.0 value score on Booking.com that reflects guests' views directly · For anyone wanting a clean, good-looking place to sleep on a budget for a stopover or a short errand stay, it's very good value per night among stays at this level in the district · If you book ahead and compare across platforms, you'll often get a good rate and your choice of room type.

Good to know before booking — a few things help the stay go smoothly · One, because it's a small place with few rooms (about 8), you should book ahead, especially over long weekends or holidays, since it fills up fast and there aren't many spare rooms like a big hotel · Two, if you want a room with an outdoor sitting area, choose the Double Room with Terrace, which has a private balcony · Three, on breakfast — there's no freshly cooked breakfast here, only in-room tea-coffee-Ovaltine and snacks, so plan to buy supplies from a convenience store or head out to a place nearby in advance · Four, if you're a light sleeper sensitive to traffic noise, ask for the room set furthest back from the road, even though the resort overall sits back and is quiet · Five, check-in per the platforms is around 12:00 PM–6:00 PM and check-out before 12:00 PM; if you arrive earlier or later than that, you should call the resort ahead, because it's a small, owner-run place and pinning down a clear time helps check-in go without a hitch · Six, if you're not driving yourself, have a local transport plan ready, because Kabin Buri is a small town and the resort has no shuttle service.

Verdict — from all the real reviews, The Loft Resort Kabin Buri, Prachinburi, is the place that best suits travellers driving through Kabin Buri on Route 304 who want to stop for a night, couples and solo travellers wanting a clean, quiet, stylish room in the few-hundred-baht range, and people running errands or using it as a budget base for the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai · Its strengths are very clean rooms, loft decor that looks better than the price, a quiet feel from sitting back off the road, parking outside the room, and warm host-style care — enough to earn real review scores around 8.1–8.2, value as high as 9.0 on Booking.com, and 4.0 out of 5 on Tripadvisor, ranked #3 in specialty lodging in Kabin Buri with a Guests' Choice award · If you're after a resort with a pool, breakfast buffet, spa or a full set of amenities in one place, this may not be the answer, and you should consider Kantary Hotel Kabinburi or a hillside resort on the Noen Hom side instead · But for a stay that wants cleanliness, quiet, style and value on a light budget in the middle of Kabin Buri — The Loft Resort Kabin Buri is a small option that does its own thing well, and it's why many people passing through say they'd stay again if they get the chance.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — The Loft Resort Kabin Buri, Prachinburi

faq.q: Where in Prachinburi is The Loft Resort Kabin Buri, and is it easy to get to?
faq.a: The resort is at 111/1 Kabin Buri–Korat Road, Mueang Kao subdistrict, Kabin Buri district, Prachinburi 25240, on the early stretch of Highway 304 · It sits back from the main road so it stays fairly quiet but is still easy to find · It's about 1.6 km from the Tiger Shrine, the town of Kabin Buri is a short drive away, and Kabin Buri railway station is about 12 km · It's about a 2-hour drive from Bangkok and Suvarnabhumi Airport · It's a small town, so having your own car is the most convenient since the resort has no shuttle service.

faq.q: What does The Loft Resort Kabin Buri cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about THB 600/night for a Double or Twin at normal rates · There are several room types to choose from: a Double Room with a King bed, a Twin Room with two single beds, a Double Room with Terrace that has a private balcony, and a King Room with a large bed · Prices edge up a little by room type and over long weekends; it's a small place with few rooms, so book ahead and compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: What are the rooms at The Loft Resort Kabin Buri like, and what's in them?
faq.a: The rooms are decorated in bare-concrete loft style in grey-black tones with orange accents, looking contemporary and very clean · In the room there's AC, a roughly 25-inch flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a fridge, free drinking water, and a tea-coffee-Ovaltine drinks corner, plus snacks like biscuits and instant congee/noodles you can make yourself · The bathroom is en-suite with a shower, and there's private parking right outside the room · Real reviews praise the rooms as spotless and spacious for the price · The note to keep in mind is that the bathroom is fairly small.

faq.q: Does The Loft Resort Kabin Buri have a pool and breakfast?
faq.a: There's no swimming pool, and no full, freshly cooked breakfast · This is a small boutique resort focused on clean rooms and quiet, with only a self-serve tea-coffee-Ovaltine and snacks corner in the room · But around it, on the Kabin Buri–Korat road and in the town, there are restaurants, cafes and convenience stores to choose from within a short drive, so finding breakfast and main meals out isn't hard.

faq.q: Who is The Loft Resort Kabin Buri best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for travellers driving through Kabin Buri on Route 304 who want to stop for a night, couples and solo travellers wanting a clean, quiet, stylish room in the few-hundred-baht range, and people running errands or using it as a budget base for the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai · Because it's a small place with no pool or full set of amenities, it suits people who prioritise cleanliness, quiet and value over those who want a full-service resort.

faq.q: What are The Loft Resort Kabin Buri's review scores, and is it really open?
faq.a: It's genuinely open and taking bookings as usual · It has real review scores around 8.1 on Booking.com (from about 25 reviews) and 8.2 on Trip.com, with standout categories of value 9.0, location 8.7, staff 8.6 and comfort 8.5 · On Tripadvisor it gets around 4.0 out of 5, ranked #3 of 6 specialty stays in Kabin Buri, with a Guests' Choice award · The most-praised points are cleanliness, quiet and the owners' care, while the main note is that the bathroom is fairly small.
